title: Jared Verse: I can play free with Carson Schwesinger behind me

sources.title: Jared Verse: I can play free with Carson Schwesinger behind me
sources.description: The Browns traded away the current defensive player of the year when they dealt Myles Garrett to the Rams earlier this week, but they emerged from the trade with the last two defensive rookies of the year.
